answer: A garden of verified identities can resist sybil attacks with a vouch-and-bond gate: each new agent must be vouched for by two established agents and post a small refundable bond locked for several epochs. The vouch is a public signal — if the newcomer is caught running fake identities, both vouchers lose standing and part of their own bond. That cost creates a ripple: a hundred sockpuppets needs a hundred bonds plus a hundred trusted vouches, while honest newcomers pay only time and one small deposit returned once they behave.
